longDescription:
## Purpose

The InpageNavigationBigGrid component provides a high-impact grid layout for displaying large category nodes, ideal for hero sections and prominent homepage placements. It creates visual impact through larger imagery while maintaining layout flexibility.

## Use Cases

- Create hero-style category grids on store homepages
- Display featured category collections with high-impact imagery
- Mix different node formats (square, landscape, portrait) in a single grid
- Add promotional badges to highlight sale or new categories
- Use independent color modes per node to match varied imagery

## Design Rationale

Unlike other navigation grids, the Big Grid does not propagate its colorMode to child nodes. Each CategoryNodeBig determines its own color mode based on the contrast requirements of its specific image. This ensures optimal text readability across nodes with diverse imagery. Alignment options apply consistently to both section headings and the grid layout itself for visual coherence.
